build_fuzzer_test_targets: build test targets from fuzzer build targets by appending one corpus entry fuzzer source
create_corpus_test_entries: create test entries for each corpus file found in the fuzzer target corpus directories
run_mako_plugin: run the mako plugin to transform fuzzer targets into test targets with corpus entries
refactor_mako_plugin: refactor the mako plugin to support additional build types beyond fuzzer targets
review_mako_plugin: review the mako plugin function that generates test targets and test entries from fuzzer targets
